method_caveats: Keyword overlap is a coarse, disclosed heuristic (shared content words between the generated follow-up and a hand-written description of the probed gap), not a semantic or human-judged groundedness measurement. It can under-detect true grounding (a follow-up can be well-grounded while using none of the same words) but cannot over-detect it beyond incidental word overlap.
N=5, one real-model call per case, no repetition per case -- indicative of current qualitative behavior, not a powered or statistically analyzed study.

This probe tests generate_followup() directly; it does not exercise the orchestrator-level strong-answer skip condition, which is a separate gate upstream of this function and is not itself an LLM call.
